sections.title: Asking the price, buying one
sections.content: *Ár* is price. Ask *Mennyibe kerül a kabát?* and answer with the price and no verb: *A kabát nyolcezer forint.* For thousands, put the number before *ezer* in one word: *háromezer*, *ötezer*, *nyolcezer*, *tízezer*. To buy one, point and use the definite verb: *Ezt veszem.* (I'll buy this one.) *Azt nem veszem.* If it is too dear, say why: *Nem veszem, mert túl drága.*

items.english: How much does the coat cost?
I won't buy it because it is too expensive.

sections.content: *Veszek* is for any one (*Egy inget veszek*); *veszem* is for the one you point at or know (*Ezt veszem*, *Veszem a kabátot*). The price has no *-t*: *nyolcezer forint*.
